title: Update - Confirmed Lifetime PurchaseI love this app
body:
Update - Everything was address. It took time but it is all working now.

I’m writing this after more than six weeks of trying in good faith to resolve a confirmed Lifetime purchase.

I genuinely love this app. That’s the only reason I’ve stayed patient and kept trying for so long.

I purchased a Lifetime membership through Habitify’s website, and the Habitify team has repeatedly confirmed in writing that my account does have Lifetime access. That part has never been in dispute.

Despite this, I have been stuck in an unresolved account access issue since mid-December. I have sent over 20 emails, worked with multiple members of the support team, and carefully followed every single step I was asked to do.

To be very clear, I have:
	•	Followed all reset instructions repeatedly
	•	Tried from both the app and the website
	•	Retried on different days and devices
	•	Checked spam and junk folders every time
	•	Recorded and sent videos of myself going through the steps exactly as requested
	•	Sent screenshots as proof

Even after all of this, the issue remains unresolved.

Support has been polite, but I keep being asked to repeat steps that have already failed or to provide historical purchase details I no longer have due to a past computer failure — despite the fact that my Lifetime membership has already been confirmed by their team.

I want to be very clear:
I am not trying to get something I didn’t pay for. I am simply asking for access to a Lifetime membership that Habitify has already acknowledged I own.

I’ve stayed respectful. I’ve stayed cooperative. I’ve stayed because I truly value this app and wanted this handled fairly. At this point, I hope this review encourages Habitify to improve how long-running issues are escalated and manually resolved when standard processes clearly aren’t working.

title: Great Habit Tracker!
body:
My yearly Strides subscription came up and took a look at my options. This app is on point. I’m switching. 

One of my gripes with other apps is you could not set your day to be anything other than resetting at 12am. Shame because maybe your ‘day’ finishes a bit later. This app does that. No more manual entry! : )

Another thing I didn’t like with the competition was that there was no organization set for each period of day. I have a morning routine, things I do during the day and evening. This app does that if you want AND you can adjust the time for each period of the day. Genius! With other apps I had to organize it myself with tags and the experience was not great nor fluid, or simply was not available and I’d just have a list. 

Plus there is a web and Mac app and the price is reasonable by comparison as well. Nice settings for habit tracking and notifications too. Great job! Thank you for a great app. I’m getting Life-Time Premium  ❤️😇✌️

Nice and simple app but I wish there was an option to track overachievement. I can’t record that I read 4 times a week if my goal was 3 times for example.
Also can’t record that I meditated twice a day (only daily options) Good for very simple use.
author: Luniboni

title: Finally an App that works me
body:
Thank you for this good habit creating monster.  I love it and Habitify is making me a better person.  It feels great to be reminded about the things I want to do and track my effectiveness.  

Thanks again,

Chris

title: Just needs one feature to be perfect
body:
I tested a bunch of Habit apps before settling on this one. The decision would have been much easier if this app had a “fail” feature for a habit rather than just not checking the box. It forces the user to experience the feeling of breaking a chain of success which I think is helpful for motivating change. 

Other than, great app! I do think it’s the best one out there.

title: I'm sure there are better apps
body: I decided to bite the bullet and purchase this app for the $5 something price tag. It doesn't offer much in terms of the habits it suggests you can start with and the option to add your own somewhat defeats the purpose. I emailed their support to inquire about a refund and despite boasting that they're willing to help and welcome inquiries, it's now been 4 days and haven't had any response back.
author: asha4203

title: Simplest and most pleasant habit tracker
body:
Really well-refined and beautiful app that tracks habits, motivates and even offers inspiring quotes through a widget.
However, latest update has brought upon a few bugs (the days are all screwed up, can only input Saturday's habit on a Monday and there seems to be a misalignment between the days and habit bars). Please fix.

body: Crashes phone in iOS 10. Please fix. Get black screen with spinning white circle.
author: yamakake

title: Not worth the space on my iPhone.
body: Seriously. If you download this app, it only allows you to track 3 habits and you can't even see the statistics past one week if you continue doing those habits over time (over a week). What's the point of this? If I want more features I have to pay $5+ for it, but it's just not worth the space and money. I can easily track my habits over a long period of time another way for free.  Nice concept but not worth it.
author: Nikolaida

title: Nothing in the free version
body:
The free version has basically NOTHING in it. You can have 3 dailies only. You cannot see progress. 
Delete immediately. Clising my account. Jab jab jab right hook guys. At least give the premium for free for a short period then when we're hooked, make us pay. No one wants to use an app for only 3 habits.

title: Belle découverte
body:
cette application est toute simple mais relève définitivement du génie elle permet à tout être humain, avec sa volonté, de modifier son comportement pour optimiser la qualité de sa vie.

 Il serait bien que cette application soit connecté avec iCloud pour être synchronisé avec tous les appareils de son propriétaire et également permettre un Storage de l'information si jamais l'appareil est perdue.

de plus le partage des isolation serait intéressant sur les principaux réseaux sociaux tels que Facebook Tom bleu Google et Twitter.
